title: Larry Ellison Personally Guaranteed $40.4 Billion of His Son's Warner Bros. Discovery Deal. Now 12 States Have Sued to Block It, and Oracle Stock Has Fallen 34% This Month.
title_zh: 拉里·埃里森 (Larry Ellison) 亲自为儿子的华纳兄弟探索交易提供 404 亿美元的担保。现在已有 12 个州提起诉讼要求阻止，甲骨文股价本月已下跌 34%。
summary: Larry Ellison's fortune, Oracle's stock, and Hollywood's biggest merger are now deeply intertwined -- and investors should understand why the outcome could matter far beyond the entertainment industry.
summary_zh: 拉里·埃里森的财富、甲骨文的股票和好莱坞最大的合并现在已经深深地交织在一起——投资者应该理解为什么结果的影响可能远远超出娱乐业。

title: Kuwait signs $16 billion oil pipeline deal with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield
title_zh: 科威特与 Blackstone、KKR 和 Brookfield 签署价值 160 亿美元的石油管道协议
summary: Investing.com -- Kuwait Petroleum Corporation has signed a $16 billion lease and leaseback agreement covering its crude oil pipeline network with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield, Reuters reported.
summary_zh: 据路透社报道，科威特石油公司已与 Blackstone、KKR 和 Brookfield 签署了价值 160 亿美元的租赁和回租协议，涵盖其原油管道网络。

title: Blackstone, Brookfield, KKR Ink $16 Billion Kuwait Pipeline Deal
title_zh: Blackstone、Brookfield 和 KKR 签署价值 160 亿美元的科威特管道交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Kuwait has agreed a $16 billion infrastructure partnership with Blackstone Inc., Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. and KKR & Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——科威特已与 Blackstone Inc.、Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. 和 KKR & Co. 达成价值 160 亿美元的基础设施合作伙伴关系。

title: Salesforce (CRM) Lands $1.6 Billion VA Deal To Power Veteran Care
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 与 VA 达成 16 亿美元交易，为退伍军人护理提供支持
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has secured a US$1.6 billion, three-year contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The Missionforce platform will be used to modernize care and service delivery for more than 17 million veterans.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）已与美国退伍军人事务部签订了一份价值 16 亿美元、为期三年的合同。 Missionforce 平台将用于为超过 1700 万退伍军人提供现代化的护理和服务。

title: ServiceNow Surges 6%, Salesforce Climbs 4% as Government AI Deals Lift Enterprise Software
title_zh: 政府人工智能交易提振企业软件，ServiceNow 飙升 6%，Salesforce 攀升 4%
summary: Federal AI contracts are pouring into enterprise software order books, and two of the sector's most beaten-down stocks are suddenly surging.
summary_zh: 联邦人工智能合同正在涌入企业软件订单簿，该行业最受打击的两只股票突然飙升。
